title: La Placita in El Pueblo
caption: La Placita church at El Pueblo, photographed in July 2007. A surviving landmark of the city’s layered history, not a depiction of the earlier Tongva village.

title: The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo
caption: Cover and seal of the treaty’s exchange copy, 1848. A historical document for the reading about the changing border and sovereignty.

title: Water arriving through the aqueduct system
caption: The Second Los Angeles Aqueduct Cascades at Sylmar, photographed in September 2008. This later part of the system illustrates water infrastructure; it is not the 1913 opening of the original aqueduct.

title: Union Station and its rail approaches
caption: A modern overhead view of Los Angeles Union Station. The photograph shows the surviving station, not the earlier Chinatown displaced by development.

title: Berry Gordy — a creative connection
caption: Motown founder Berry Gordy at a performance of The Hot Chocolate Nutcracker in December 2010. A later portrait connected to the organization’s history, not a photograph of its 1972 move to Los Angeles.

title: Japanese American National Museum
caption: The museum in Little Tokyo, photographed in November 2010. A place of remembrance; this is not an image of forced removal in 1942 or a claim that the cited 2022 exhibition is still running.

title: The Great Wall of Los Angeles
caption: The northern end of the Great Wall, photographed in December 2024. A view of the mural’s setting and its more recent timeline sections.

title: Lupines on former railway land
caption: Lupines at Rio de Los Angeles State Park, March 2010. The park occupies part of the former Taylor Yard landscape; this is contextual imagery, not a photograph or rendering of the proposed Paseo del Rio project.
